notes: A fragmentary speech-recognition transcript of a 防災行政無線 broadcast, written during the event as test material. The place is heard as なかはら…がっこう, which matches both 中原小学校 and 中原中学校, so place_id stays null with the heard spelling in place_text_ja. The hour is garbled (じゅう、じ), so valid_from stays null rather than a guess. The repeat (くりかえします) is the same fact, not a second one. The opening and closing formulas are not facts. Bring a container is the one condition.
